_comment: Per-skill skips for scripts/test-skills-render.mjs fence extraction. '<skill>': 'all' skips every fence; {'targets': ['store/index.ts']} skips fences by declared destination path; {'fences': [0,2]} skips by fence index (brittle — prefer targets; indexes count ts/tsx fences top-to-bottom). Fences with no import/export line, or with elided '...' import lists, are auto-skipped as docs shapes. Keep entries justified — every skip is untested prose code.

iblai-vibe-agent-chat.reason: partial store-wiring fragment (imports + bare reducer map to merge into an existing store), not a compilable module

iblai-vibe-agent-sandbox.reason: SDK v2 d.ts gap: useGetMentorSettingsQuery / useEditMentorJsonMutation exist at runtime but are missing from data-layer typings

iblai-vibe-agent-skills.reason: Partial snippet: shows only the useAgentGrants call and the slashSkillsEnabled prop on <Chat>, whose required props (config, username, …) come from /iblai-vibe-agent-chat

iblai-vibe-profile.reason: SDK v2 d.ts gap: the career-profile CRUD hooks (useGetUserEducationQuery et al.) exist at runtime but are missing from data-layer typings

iblai-vibe-ops-test.reason: snippets assume @testing-library/jest-dom matcher typings, which the skill installs into the target app; vibe-starter does not ship them

iblai-vibe-monetization-checkout.reason: documents v1-era monetization hooks: useCheckAccessQuery/useGetPublicPricingQuery are absent from the v2 runtime, the rest from typings — needs an SDK/API verification pass and a skill refresh

iblai-vibe-monetization-onboard.reason: Stripe-Connect onboarding hooks absent from v2 data-layer typings — same refresh needed as monetization-checkout

iblai-vibe-course-access.reason: documents v1-era course hooks: useGetDepartmentMemberCheckQuery is gone from the v2 runtime entirely, useCourseNavigator/exam/enrollment hooks are d.ts gaps — the skill needs a v2 rewrite
